items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know him at all? No, I heard of him. I believe Fred introduced me to him. But he did. Flying trumpet man.

ctx.x: You know who he played? I don't think so. He's from Algiers, boy. He's from Ovin' Algiers.
You know him at all? No, I heard of him. I believe Fred introduced me to him. But he did. Flying trumpet man.
Now, if you could ask him more about the other drummers, I don't know who you've talked about, but what about the Matthew boys, how many of those did you hear?

items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Now when I tell guys I played with him... That's the man Buddy, old man Petit.

ctx.x: Well that sounds like the Eureka band, what's your name? Willie Webber and Willie Wilson. Yeah. Do you know Willie Wilson's brother? Yeah, just to play baritone.

Johnny. Yeah, I know him. Well all those fellas I used to go sit down and listen at the rehearsals when they had it, at Willie Parker's house. I tried to think of this old fella who played trombone. I used to get a kick out of it man, he's a low shot fella. Buddy something. He's got some relation, still living playing music in the way for the end. Buddy, is that Buddy from Al Jills? No, no, this old man is from the Ron Wood, Ron Jill Nichols neighborhood. I can't think of this guy's name.
Is he a relative of Buddy Petit, says Buddy?
